text: Security is a crucial part of web development. When you build a website, you must protect both your users and your data. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt information sent between the browser and the server. Second, strong authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Third, input validation is essential because it stops harmful data from entering your system. Developers should also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which attackers often exploit. By following these practices, you can reduce risks and create safer web applications for everyone.
